topic: Someone discovers their neighbor is secretly wealthy
text: You ever notice how quiet a room gets when you realize something’s off, like the neighbor you’ve waved at every morning might as well be royalty behind those drawn curtains? It’s the kind of thing that gnaws at you, the way a corner of a loose tooth does. I get the call, just another voice in the rain, telling me about lights on late and fancy cars sneaking in at odd hours. The kind of cars that say more than a few hushed words in the night. I tell myself it’s just curiosity, the kind that killed the cat, but it’s more. It’s the thin edge of a wedge splitting open a life you thought you knew. I’ll take the case, because sometimes the truth is the only thing left when the world around you starts to crack.
